title: Vietnamese Keto Beef Stir Fry
description: Quick and easy keto stir fry with beef, herbs, and a hint of Vietnamese flavors. This dish can be cooked in under 30 minutes and is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add 2 tablespoons of Vietnamese stir-fry sauce and stir to combine.
Return beef to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in chopped cilantro and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
